parts.text: I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I plan and run the flights by deciding which drone flies and along which way before signing off a flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. I want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts, but our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
